notes: pilot-300: F0 pass rate (k=8) on ALL eligible train items -> keep 1..7 passes -> N=300, K=4 training from F0 -> reload -> sentinel F0/FT.

prefilter.items = number of eligible distinct-structure train items. Get it on CPU with the same flags: `local_run propose-proof ... --train-problems 1 --problems-per-update 1 --max-updates 1 --output /tmp/count.json`, then items = len(fixed) + len(selection_source.dropped_ids). A larger value is refused by propose-proof, a smaller one measures only the first items in the rule's hash order.

vllm values must equal the ones stage1 measured with (or be re-decided before the pilot; they are protocol-bound). train.max_seconds and the timeouts are set from the stage1 receipt via pod/cost.py before G4.
